tasks.title: ISO C11 Checked Aligned Arena Allocator
tasks.query: Implement an ISO C11 bump arena allocator with overflow-checked power-of-two alignment and ASan/UBSan verification.

tasks.title: Native x86_64 System V ABI Assembly Dot Product
tasks.query: Implement a native x86_64 assembly dot product routine obeying the System V AMD64 ABI and verify linkage from C11.

tasks.title: Native WebAssembly Binary Instantiation & HDL CDC Verification
tasks.query: Construct and instantiate a binary WebAssembly module in Node.js V8 and verify SystemVerilog clock-domain crossing invariants.

tasks.title: SQLite3 ACID Transaction & Parameterized Injection Defense
tasks.query: Implement an ACID SQLite3 ledger transfer with parameterized queries preventing SQL injection and verify index usage via EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN.

tasks.title: OS Virtual Memory Copy-on-Write (CoW) Page Fault Handler
tasks.query: Implement an operating system virtual memory Copy-on-Write page-fault handler with physical frame reference counting and TLB shootdown tracking.

tasks.title: OS Write-Ahead Journaling Filesystem Crash Recovery
tasks.query: Implement a filesystem write-ahead log (WAL) replay engine that prevents torn writes and guarantees idempotent crash recovery.

tasks.title: Linux Kernel eBPF Packet Bounds Verifier & Module Cleanup
tasks.query: Implement an eBPF XDP packet parser that satisfies pointer-arithmetic verifier bounds before header access in the Linux kernel.

tasks.title: Linux From Scratch 3-Stage Toolchain Bootstrap & ELF PT_INTERP Validator
tasks.query: Verify a Linux From Scratch 3-stage cross-toolchain dependency DAG and audit ELF64 PT_INTERP against host /lib64 contamination.

tasks.title: Kernel Interrupt-Safe Seqlock & Acquire-Release Ordering
tasks.query: Implement an interrupt-safe kernel seqlock protocol in C11 atomics with odd-sequence spin detection and acquire-release fences.

tasks.title: Compiler Frontend Hindley-Milner Type Inference with Occurs-Check
tasks.query: Implement a compiler frontend Hindley-Milner type inference engine (Algorithm W) with occurs-check rejection of infinite recursive types.

tasks.title: Compiler Backend ELF64 Relocation & CFG Dominator Engine
tasks.query: Implement an ELF64 R_X86_64_PC32 relocation engine with 32-bit signed displacement overflow checks and CFG dominator tree verification.

tasks.title: Tri-Color GC Dijkstra Write Barrier & Stage-2/3 Self-Hosting Verification
tasks.query: Verify a new programming language tri-color mark-sweep garbage collector write barrier and Stage-2 == Stage-3 self-hosting compiler fixed point.
